notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, random arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Top examples and strong band samples are nearly all source code (Python) at structural tokens (newline after a line, ' =', '#', commented-out 'if'/'print'), but only 2.4% of tokens exceed 0.1 of max and a few strong hits are prose ('var' in various, a period in fiction), so the label covers only part of the pole. Near misses are prose and lists about the same topics, and no non-Python code was tested.
